property_summary: For any initialized setup, any caller and any ref, one call to collectDrugs adds exactly floor(elapsedCappedDrugs/86400) kilos to Kilos[caller] (one kilo per full 86400 drug cycle, capped at one day's worth), whereas the mutant adds twice that (two kilos).

In the reference contract, a second collectDrugs call at the same timestamp adds no new Kilos (pending drugs were consumed by resetting lastCollect); the mutant leaves lastCollect stale, so the same accrued drugs are converted to Kilos twice, changing Kilos on the second call.
